summary: DeepInfra's DeepStart program grants 1,000,000,000 (one billion) free inference tokens, valued at DeepSeek V3.1 prices, usable across DeepInfra's hosted model catalog. Eligibility is narrow: the startup must have raised between $250K and $10M USD and been founded within the last 2 years.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: raised $250K-$10M USD, founded within the last 2 years.
Apply via the DeepStart page at https://deepinfra.com/deepstart .
On acceptance, 1B tokens are credited for inference at DeepSeek V3.1 prices.
